questions.question_text:
$f:x\mapsto\begin{cases}x-2,&0\le x<\pi\\\sin x,&x\ge\pi\end{cases}$.
What is the domain of $f$?

options.why: Includes only the second branch and omits the interval from 0 to pi.
Stops at pi and omits the branch defined for every x greater than pi.
The two branches together cover every real x from zero onwards.

questions.solution_text: The first branch covers $0\le x<\pi$ and the second covers $x\ge\pi$. Their union is $x\ge0$.
